These short in-class quizzes connect AI fluency with the foundational technical ideas in each lecture. You will examine an AI-generated answer, identify the claim that matters most, test it against course evidence, and make a defensible decision.

## What is graded

For open-ended judgments, grading emphasizes your reasoning process: the claim you select, the evidence you use, and how well your conclusion follows. When a question has a clear right or wrong answer, such as a calculation or definition, correctness matters.
